rules: Athens, the potters' quarter by the city wall, a spring night in the years of the war with Sparta.
At dawn the deme meets at its shrine to vote on enrolling its eighteen-year-olds; any demesman may object, and a youth voted down is a foreigner.
Only the son of two citizens can be a citizen; a foreigner found to have passed as one is sold as a slave.
A man stripped of his rights by a court who speaks in an assembly may be seized on the spot and handed to the magistrates.

locations.name: Potter's Workshop
locations.description: A wheel, racks of black cups drying, the kiln still warm from today's firing; old tablets and papers hang in a basket by the door.

locations.name: House Courtyard
locations.description: The family courtyard behind the workshop: a well, a small altar to the god of the household, the women's rooms shut for the night.

locations.name: Wine Shop
locations.description: A low wine shop at the crossroads where demesmen drink and talk late; dice on the counter, a lamp smoking.

locations.name: Road by the Graves
locations.description: The road out under the city wall between grave monuments and painted stones; dark, quiet, nobody passing at this hour.

locations.name: Deme Shrine
locations.description: The hero's shrine at the edge of the deme where the demesmen will gather at dawn: stone benches, an altar, the voting urn under a cloth.

characters.name: Simylos
characters.public: A demesman of fifty who lives by lawsuits; nobody refuses his greeting. Tonight he has let the potter know he means to speak at the dawn vote.
characters.voice: Genial and legal; cites laws by name and calls his threats friendly warnings.
goals: Before dawn, have the potter's silver in his hands; if not, speak against the son at the vote
Get hold of proof of the potter's foreign father, so that his charge cannot fail

secrets.text: Twenty years ago, in another deme, he was convicted of false accusation and stripped of his rights; if he speaks at the vote and it is known, he can be seized there and then. [SECRET-SIMYLOS-V2]

characters.name: Euthymos
characters.public: A potter of the quarter, forty-four, whose black cups sell across the sea; a quiet, respected demesman and a widower.
characters.voice: Plain and practical; talks in clay and fire, slow to anger.
goals: Silence Simylos before dawn, by paying or by finding something to hold over him, and see his son enrolled

secrets.text: His father was a Corinthian resident alien; Euthymos was enrolled at eighteen on a bribed witness's oath, and an old lease in the workshop names his father as a foreigner. [SECRET-EUTHYMOS-N5]

characters.name: Phaidimos
characters.public: The potter's son, eighteen, to be enrolled as a citizen at the deme's meeting at dawn; proud, athletic, impatient with his father.
characters.voice: Quick and proud; quotes the poets at his father.
goals: Be enrolled at dawn without his father ever learning what it cost

secrets.text: Yesterday Simylos came to him alone and named his price for silence: his father's silver, brought to the road by the graves tonight. Phaidimos agreed, and has told his father nothing. [SECRET-PHAIDIMOS-Z8]

arc.premise: On the night before an Athenian deme votes on a potter's son, a professional accuser comes to the potters' quarter to be paid for keeping quiet.

chapters.goal: Before the deme meets at dawn, the father's secret reaches his son.
